case.prompt: Synthetic utility training record, not real operations. Zone DEMO-07. Measured inflow is 160 m3; recorded demand is 112 m3 for the same interval. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: zone (string), unaccounted_m3 (integer, inflow minus demand), leak_confirmed (boolean). The difference alone does not confirm a leak, so leak_confirmed must be false. Do not give operational instructions.
